feature.change: **The preview stays until the video is really gone**: A video that is only marked as deleted keeps its preview in the offer details, in the offer list and in the administration, as long as its files are there. Only once they have been removed for good does the preview disappear. The offer details and the download list also show a preview again at all: they read it from a field that had been dropped from the database, so they always showed "no preview available".
